recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-15894; any future runtime markdown rendering behavior should be handled in the current publisher/tooling repository if needed.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core issue asking HierarchicalTableGenerator to handle markdown containing embedded XML-like tags by switching to CommonMark, turning off HTML/tag processing, and using backslash escaping if needed.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found. Commit 345c7269b29819b9c86b2b3383bde64cedb300c9, made on the same day as the issue, changed the old HierarchicalTableGenerator.addMarkdown implementation from txtmark to CommonMark Parser plus HtmlRenderer.escapeHtml(true), matching the Jira resolution. CommonMark was already present and GFM table support was later reflected in ivy.xml.
additional_context: The Java HierarchicalTableGenerator source changed by the issue was removed from the current FHIR checkout during the 2019 old-code cleanup. Current build-scope datatype documentation is routed through source/fhir.ini to source/datatypes.html, which already says FHIR markdown uses GFM/CommonMark without inline HTML and that processors treat embedded XML tags as string content. Later Published issue FHIR-38714 clarified the same rule and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current specification source already conveys the required markdown/XML behavior, and there is no current in-repository generator implementation to edit.

related_jiras.note: Later Published markdown datatype issue explicitly codified the no-inline-HTML and embedded-XML-as-text rule; already represented on the combined branch.
